department: Agriculture Department, Government of the Punjab

schemes.scheme_name: CM Punjab Kisan Card Initiative (وزیر اعلیٰ کسان کارڈ)
schemes.benefit: Interest-free production loan of up to PKR 150,000 (PKR 30,000 per acre up to 5 acres) disbursed via Bank of Punjab (BOP) Kisan Card for purchasing certified seed, fertilizer, and pesticides from registered dealers.
schemes.eligibility: Smallholder farmers cultivating up to 12.5 acres with verified land ownership records in Land Record Authority (PLRA), mobile SIM registered on CNIC, and no previous bank defaults.
schemes.how_to_apply: Send CNIC number to 8070 via SMS or visit nearest Agriculture Extension office / Bank of Punjab branch.

schemes.scheme_name: Subsidized Fertilizer & DAP Voucher Program (کھاد سبسڈی پروگرام)
schemes.benefit: Direct cash subsidy of PKR 1,000 to 1,500 per bag on Phosphate (DAP) and Potash (SOP/MOP) fertilizers redeemed through scratch-card vouchers inside authorized bags.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers registered on the Punjab Kisan Portal with valid CNIC and biometric verification at retail points.
schemes.how_to_apply: Scratch the voucher code found inside the fertilizer bag and SMS the code along with CNIC to 8070.

schemes.scheme_name: Chief Minister Green Tractor Scheme (گرین ٹریکٹر سکیم)
schemes.benefit: Government subsidy of PKR 1,000,000 to PKR 1,500,000 per tractor on 50HP to 85HP locally manufactured tractors (Millat, Al-Ghazi).
schemes.eligibility: Farmers owning 1 to 50 acres of agricultural land in Punjab selected via transparent computerized balloting.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online at gts.punjab.gov.pk or through Punjab Agriculture Extension field formations.

schemes.scheme_name: Solarization of Agricultural Tubewells (زرعی ٹیوب ویلوں کی سولرائزیشن)
schemes.benefit: 75% government subsidy on converting existing diesel or electric tubewells to solar PV power systems (farmer contributes 25%).
schemes.eligibility: Farmers having functional tubewells with water table within permissible depth and up to 25 acres landholding.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit application to the Directorate General Agriculture (Water Management) Punjab.

schemes.scheme_name: Crop Loan Insurance Scheme - CLIS / Takaful (فصل بیمہ پروگرام)
schemes.benefit: 100% premium subsidy paid by government for small farmers taking institutional agricultural loans to cover losses from excessive rain, floods, pests, or drought for wheat, cotton, rice, and sugarcane.
schemes.eligibility: All borrowing small farmers with landholding up to 12.5 acres.
schemes.how_to_apply: Automatically activated when obtaining an agricultural production loan through ZTBL, BOP, or commercial banks.
